name: Steeplewell
tagline: The quiet system behind a well-run congregation.
positioning: Steeplewell gives small churches one calm place for members, giving, and Sunday logistics — so your team spends less time in spreadsheets.

hero.h1: Run your church like the ministry it is, not the paperwork it became.
hero.sub: Steeplewell keeps your directory, giving records, and weekly service plan in sync — so the pastor, the treasurer, and the volunteer coordinator all see the same truth.

features.title: A directory that stays current
features.description: Families update their own contact details and photos. New-visitor cards flow straight into follow-up, so nobody slips through after their first Sunday.

features.title: Giving without the reconciliation dread
features.description: Track envelopes, online gifts, and pledges in one ledger. Year-end contribution statements generate in a click, correct to the cent.

features.title: Sunday, planned in one place
features.description: Build the order of service, assign readers and greeters, and confirm the nursery rota — then publish it to every volunteer's phone.

features.title: Messages people actually read
features.description: Send the weekly bulletin by email or text, segment by ministry, and see who opened it. No more forwarding chains from the office inbox.

features.title: Volunteers who know their shift
features.description: Automated reminders and easy swaps mean fewer empty spots on the coffee table and the sound board come Sunday morning.

features.title: Records you can trust at review time
features.description: Every membership change, gift, and baptism is logged with a date and a name — ready for the board meeting or the annual report.

testimonials.quote: Our treasurer used to spend two full evenings each January on contribution statements. This year it took her twenty minutes, and not one family called with a correction.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ellery

testimonials.quote: I run the office for a 180-member parish alone. Steeplewell is the first tool that didn't assume I had an IT department. I set up giving and the directory in an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Diane Okafor

testimonials.quote: Volunteer scheduling was chaos on paper. Now greeters, ushers, and nursery workers confirm their own shifts, and I can finally see gaps before Sunday instead of during it.
testimonials.name: Wesley Tran

pricing.blurb: For small churches getting the office out of spreadsheets.
For growing congregations coordinating staff and volunteers.
For multi-site churches and networks with shared oversight.

homepage.footerBlurb: Steeplewell is church administration software for small congregations who'd rather tend their people than their paperwork.
